Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated October 5, 1932.

Communist Propaganda - Result of Court proceedings

Tseu Lien Ching (周濂卿), who was arrested during the
course of a raid on August 10, 1932 on the Wo Foong (胡風)
Bookstore, No.734 Tsepoo Road, where a quantity of
reactionary literature was seized, was sentenced by the
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court on September 30, 1932
to a fine of $200.00; the seized literature being
ordered confiscated.

My name is Tseu Lee Kying (周廉卿), aged 34 years, native
of Zaushing, employed as an accountant in the Woo Fong Bookshop
(湖風書局) No.734 Tsapoo Road, at which premises I also reside with
my wife and family.

My native address is as follows:- Ching Tsz Oo Village
(盛墟村) Tsz C i (諸暨), Zaushing.

On attaining the age of 8 years I commenced to study with
a private tutor, and on attaining 19 years of age I was enrolled
as a student in the Chekiang Marine Products School, Haimung.
At the age of 22 years I left the aforementioned school and was
unsuccessful in obtaining employment, so resided with my father-
in-law for a period of three years, when I left Zaushing for the
Whampoa Military Training School, Canton for further study, but
as I was unsuccessful in passing the entrance examination, I
obtained a situation as clerk in the school. After remaining
in this situation for about four months, I left on account of ill
health, and was unemployed for a long period.

In the year 1925 I proceeded to Peiping to seek employment,
and obtained a position in the Military Library, North-West Army
Corps, under the command of General Feng Yui Hsiang (馮玉祥)
where I remained until 1926.

During the period between 1926 and 1932, I held diverse
appointments in various Military Commands.

On the 1st Jan. 1931 I joined the 25th Route Army, having
obtained an appointment as Assistant Paymaster at the 'quarters
of the Army Corps, near Kanchow.
